coverageOfThePilot.how: Counted from the pinned downloads for the sources that were fetched. Census wards, ward boundaries, MPD maps, Sentinel-2 and VIIRS were not downloaded in this bench: AD2 (hand-drawn areas seeded by OSM land use and colony names, with the footprint grid as evidence) does not need them, and three of them need an account or have no open licence.

scanned PDFs with no open licence: reference only

featureTable100m.how: If time item, done for three pilot districts: per 100 m cell the building count and coverage, median footprint, road metres, open ground share and a mean height hint. The full tables are files beside this report.
